2. Heats from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps

{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_3/silicon_melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, K, bars)

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Compute temperature and pressure
compute         mytemp all temp
compute         mypress all pressure mytemp

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps (NPT)
# ============================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             100000  # 100 ps initial equilibration
unfix           3

# ============================================
# Stage 4: Production run at 2500K with MSD calculation
# ============================================
# Reset timestep for MSD calculation
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermo output with MSD
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd[4]
thermo          1000

# NPT ensemble at 2500K
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Dump MSD data
fix             msd_output all print 1000 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

# Run for 400 ps (production)
run             400000

unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

Perfect! Now I need to calculate the diffusion coefficient from the MSD data. According to the Einstein relation:

D = MSD / (6t)

where MSD is the mean squared displacement and t is time. Let me create a Python script to analyze this data:

{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_3/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = steps * 0.001  # time in ps

# Fit linear region to get diffusion coefficient
# Skip initial transient (first 50 ps) and use data from 50-400 ps
start_idx = np.where(time_ps >= 50)[0][0]
end_idx = len(time_ps)

time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = slope / 6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D in Angstrom^2/ps
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# D [m^2/s] = D [A^2/ps] * (1e-10)^2 / (1e-12) = D [A^2/ps] * 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit from {time_fit[0]:.1f} to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion Coefficient Calculation for Liquid Silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=" * 70 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit range: {time_fit[0]:.1f} to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer (scientific notation): {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Final answer (decimal): {D_m2_s:.10f} m^2/s\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}
